questions.question: Which film includes the line “Are you not entertained?”?
questions.note: Russell Crowe’s Maximus, after a slaughter in the arena.

questions.question: Which 2004 teen comedy includes the line “Stop trying to make fetch happen”?
questions.note: Regina George (Rachel McAdams) shutting down Gretchen Wieners.

questions.question: Which film includes the line “I wish I knew how to quit you”?
questions.note: 2005 — Jake Gyllenhaal’s Jack Twist to Heath Ledger’s Ennis Del Mar.

questions.question: In which film does Captain Jack Sparrow demand to know, “Why is the rum gone?”?
questions.answer: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
choices: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest
Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
questions.note: 2003 — the first of the Disney series, with Johnny Depp.

questions.question: Which film includes the gangster-movie line “Keep the change, ya filthy animal”?
questions.note: Kevin is watching a fake movie called Angels with Filthy Souls.

questions.question: In which film does Tony Stark first publicly say, “I am Iron Man”?
questions.note: The 2008 press conference. Endgame’s snap line is “And I am Iron Man.”

questions.question: In which Harry Potter film does Snape answer “Always” to “After all this time?”?
questions.answer: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 2
choices: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 2
Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 1
questions.note: The Prince’s Tale, in Dumbledore’s office, about Lily Potter.

questions.question: Which film includes the line “That rug really tied the room together”?
questions.note: Jeff Bridges’s Dude, after a case of mistaken identity ruins his living room.

questions.question: Which 1994 comedy includes the line “So you’re telling me there’s a chance”?
questions.note: Jim Carrey’s Lloyd, after Lauren Holly’s Mary says the odds are like one in a million.

questions.question: Which Pixar film includes the sharks’ motto “Fish are friends, not food”?
questions.note: Bruce, the vegetarian great white, running a 12-step program.
